parameters.query:
-- Pre-flight: read workflow_settings + workflow_state for the analyzer
-- and decide whether to proceed.
WITH s AS (
  SELECT *
    FROM workflow_settings
   WHERE workflow_key = 'situational-analyzer-v0'
   LIMIT 1
),
t AS (
  SELECT *
    FROM workflow_state
   WHERE workflow_key = 'situational-analyzer-v0'
   LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  s.enabled,
  s.dry_run,
  s.daily_budget_cents,
  s.per_run_budget_cents,
  s.max_runs_per_day,
  s.min_minutes_between_runs,
  t.last_run_at,
  t.current_day_utc,
  t.runs_today,
  t.cost_cents_today,
  -- gating booleans
  COALESCE(s.enabled, false) AS gate_enabled,
  COALESCE(t.cost_cents_today, 0) < COALESCE(s.daily_budget_cents, 500) AS gate_budget,
  COALESCE(t.runs_today, 0) < COALESCE(s.max_runs_per_day, 6) AS gate_rate_count,
  (t.last_run_at IS NULL OR t.last_run_at < (now() - make_interval(mins => s.min_minutes_between_runs))) AS gate_rate_time
FROM s LEFT JOIN t ON true;

-- LOOP 1.1 — recompute priority_score on open cycle_items.
-- The math stays auditable; user_priority_override is NEVER touched.
-- DRY-RUN flag flips the UPDATE to a SELECT (returning would-have-mutated rows).
WITH s AS (SELECT dry_run FROM workflow_settings WHERE workflow_key='situational-analyzer-v0' LIMIT 1)
SELECT
  ci.id,
  ci.priority_score AS prev_score,
  ROUND(
    COALESCE((ci.priority_factors->>'urgency')::numeric, 0) * 0.6
    + COALESCE((ci.priority_factors->>'dollar_friction')::numeric, 0) * 10 * 0.4
    + COALESCE((ci.priority_factors->>'deadline_pressure')::numeric, 0),
    2
  ) AS new_score,
  (SELECT dry_run FROM s) AS dry_run
FROM cycle_items ci
WHERE (ci.disposition IS NULL OR ci.disposition = 'pending')
  AND ci.priority_factors <> '{}'::jsonb;

-- LOOP 1.2 — roll forward past-cycle items to deferred-next-cycle.
-- POE binding: never 'rejected', always 'deferred-next-cycle'.
-- DRY-RUN-aware: when dry_run, skip the UPDATE and return a preview.
WITH s AS (SELECT dry_run FROM workflow_settings WHERE workflow_key='situational-analyzer-v0' LIMIT 1),
candidates AS (
  SELECT ci.id, ci.disposition AS prev_disposition, rc.cycle_end
    FROM cycle_items ci
    JOIN review_cycles rc ON rc.id = ci.cycle_id
   WHERE rc.cycle_end < now()
     AND rc.status IN ('completed','skipped')
     AND (ci.disposition IS NULL OR ci.disposition = 'pending')
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM review_cycles rc2
        WHERE rc2.cadence_id = rc.cadence_id
          AND rc2.cycle_start > now()
     )
)
SELECT id, prev_disposition, cycle_end, (SELECT dry_run FROM s) AS dry_run FROM candidates;

parameters.query:
-- LOOP 1.3 — mark projects stale or active based on activity recency.
-- Stale is a UI surface only; nothing destructive.
WITH s AS (SELECT dry_run FROM workflow_settings WHERE workflow_key='situational-analyzer-v0' LIMIT 1)
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.status AS prev_status,
  CASE
    WHEN p.updated_at > (now() - interval '24 hours') THEN 'active'
    WHEN p.updated_at < (now() - interval '7 days') AND p.status = 'in-progress' THEN 'stale'
    ELSE p.status
  END AS new_status,
  (SELECT dry_run FROM s) AS dry_run
FROM projects p
WHERE p.status IN ('active','in-progress','stale');

-- FEEDBACK INGESTION 2.1 — pull new feedback since last run.
-- triage_status 'declined' is intentionally excluded (a future migration will drop it).
SELECT f.id, f.tenant_id AS instance_id, f.user_id, f.display_name, f.feedback_text,
       f.sentiment, f.submitted_at, f.triage_status, f.is_confidential, f.which_tab
  FROM feedback f, workflow_state t
 WHERE t.workflow_key = 'situational-analyzer-v0'
   AND f.submitted_at > COALESCE(t.last_run_at, now() - interval '4 hours')
   AND f.triage_status IN ('new','needs-info')
 ORDER BY f.submitted_at ASC;

-- LOOP 2.1 setup — assemble per-project Done/Doing/Stale signals for the
-- Anthropic call. We don't make the Anthropic call here in the JSON itself;
-- a downstream HTTP node calls Anthropic and the markdown is assembled.
-- This query is the data the Anthropic prompt is built from.
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.status, p.updated_at,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('title', ci.title, 'at', ci.disposition_at))
              FROM cycle_items ci
             WHERE ci.item_id = p.id AND ci.disposition = 'approved'
             ORDER BY ci.disposition_at DESC LIMIT 5
          ), '[]'::json) AS done,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('title', ci.title, 'priority', ci.priority_score))
              FROM cycle_items ci
             WHERE ci.item_id = p.id AND COALESCE(ci.disposition, 'pending') = 'pending'
             ORDER BY COALESCE(ci.user_priority_override, ci.priority_score) DESC LIMIT 3
          ), '[]'::json) AS doing
 FROM projects p
WHERE p.status IN ('active','in-progress','stale')
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC;

-- POST-RUN — update workflow_state and write a final audit_log row.
WITH d AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS today)
INSERT INTO workflow_state
  (workflow_key, last_run_at, last_run_status, last_run_summary,
   current_day_utc, runs_today, cost_cents_today, last_ntfy_ping_at, updated_at)
VALUES
  ('situational-analyzer-v0', now(), 'ok',
   'see audit_log for details',
   (SELECT today FROM d), 1, 0, now(), now())
ON CONFLICT (workflow_key) DO UPDATE
   SET last_run_at        = EXCLUDED.last_run_at,
       last_run_status    = EXCLUDED.last_run_status,
       last_run_summary   = EXCLUDED.last_run_summary,
       runs_today         = CASE
                              WHEN workflow_state.current_day_utc = EXCLUDED.current_day_utc
                              THEN workflow_state.runs_today + 1
                              ELSE 1 END,
       current_day_utc    = EXCLUDED.current_day_utc,
       cost_cents_today   = CASE
                              WHEN workflow_state.current_day_utc = EXCLUDED.current_day_utc
                              THEN workflow_state.cost_cents_today
                              ELSE 0 END,
       last_ntfy_ping_at  = EXCLUDED.last_ntfy_ping_at,
       updated_at         = EXCLUDED.updated_at
 RETURNING runs_today, cost_cents_today;

-- Exit-early path: write a 'disabled' / 'budget-exhausted' / 'rate-limited' row.
UPDATE workflow_state
   SET last_run_at = now(),
       last_run_status = CASE
         WHEN NOT (SELECT enabled FROM workflow_settings WHERE workflow_key='situational-analyzer-v0') THEN 'disabled'
         ELSE 'rate-limited' END,
       updated_at = now()
 WHERE workflow_key = 'situational-analyzer-v0'
 RETURNING last_run_status;
